__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading. Authored artifacts may add or omit sections, so this is advisory (additionalProperties is permitted) and no section is individually required.

Epic hypothesis statement.description: Use exactly one hypothesis block in this canonical form

Portfolio outcome rationale.description: Why this Epic matters to the portfolio in outcome terms.

Enterprise-Architect runway (EA hat).description: Cross-product architectural implications, NFR backbone, shared enablers, and which products must build runway. Enabler Epics live mostly here. May spawn product-level ADRs (those remain product-scoped, authored by `@system-architect`).

Affected products & Feature seeds.description: Use one row per product seed in this form

MVP & pivot/persevere.description: The smallest Feature set (`mvpFeatures`) that validates the hypothesis. After the MVP, the Business Owner decides pivot / persevere / stop at ★ Epic Gate review or Inspect & Adapt.

Work-item relations.description: Use only relation types that change planning or governance behavior.

Open items.description: The human-readable companion to the `openItems:` frontmatter ledger (the [open-item ledger](../../../../orchestrator/SKILL.md#open-item-ledger)) — this Epic's **clarifications** (proactive unknowns surfaced by the CE Discovery turn) and **challenges** (reactive findings from peer review), formal...

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

status.description: funnel | reviewing | analyzing | portfolio-backlog | implementing | done | blocked

workItemRelations.description: Typed work-item relations (dependsOn / enables / relatedTo / supersedes).

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

openItems.description: clarification + challenge ledger — see orchestrator "Open-item ledger". Each entry: { id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, … }; kind: clarification | challenge. status: open | resolved | withdrawn. A blocking+open entry HALTS the ★ Epic Gate.

cost.description: token cost accounting — see the cost-snapshot invariant instructions

github.description: filled by portfolio/_sync (Portfolio Project); null when authoring

enterpriseArchitect.description: the EA-hat owner of the runway (you)

products.description: product slugs this Epic spans (>=1); cross-product is allowed HERE only

mvpFeatures.description: Feature ids that constitute the MVP (the pivot/persevere test)

sources.description: Derivation provenance (narrowed subtype of the base contract's sources): refs to the upstream artifact(s) this epic was built from. Allowed source kinds: strategic-themes.

tokensIn.description: NET-NEW prompt tokens = sum(inputTokens - cachedTokens) of this item's dispatches.

tokensOut.description: Sum of outputTokens of those dispatches.

tokensCached.description: Sum of cachedTokens (re-sent context); excluded from tokensSelf, kept for billed-cost reconstruction.

tokensSelf.description: tokensIn + tokensOut - the item's own net cost.

tokensRolled.description: tokensSelf plus the rolled cost of child items - the item's end-to-end cost.

dispatches.description: Number of subagent dispatches counted into tokensSelf (not llm_request turns).

source.description: Provenance of the cost figures: measured, estimated, or mixed.

committed.description: YYYY-MM-DD the one-time cost snapshot was written; immutable after (null until committed).

githubSync.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

issueNumber.description: GitHub issue number; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

issueNodeId.description: GitHub issue node id; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

projectItemId.description: GitHub Projects item id; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

openItems.description: Clarification + challenge ledger entries (each an object: id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, ...).

dependsOn.description: Hard prerequisite artifact ids that must advance or land before this item.

enables.description: Artifact ids this item intentionally makes possible or materially easier.

relatedTo.description: Non-gating semantic or strategic links; never use as a hidden dependency list.

supersedes.description: Artifact ids intentionally replaced by this item.

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block used to rank the backlog.

userBusinessValue.description: Relative user/business value of the work item.

timeCriticality.description: How time-sensitive the value is (it decays if delayed).

jobSize.description: Relative size/effort of the job (the WSJF denominator).

score.description: Computed WSJF score = (userBusinessValue + timeCriticality + riskReduction) / jobSize.
